title: Counter controls
html: Count: 0
js: const out=root.querySelector('[data-count]'); const render=()=>{out.textContent=String(api.getState('counter') ?? 0);}; const set=n=>{api.setState('counter',n); render();}; root.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.dataset.action;if(!a)return;const n=Number(api.getState('counter') ?? 0);if(a==='inc')set(n+1);if(a==='dec')set(n-1);if(a==='reset')set(0);}); render();
